title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Days before Airi's birthday
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, these steps here are going great too! Last is the turn, and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! That was amazing, Airi!
You pulled off that dance perfectly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You stayed nice and sharp to the very end! Just what we've come to expect.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? That's good to hear.
That said, there's still a few days left before my birthday stream... I'll need to keep raising the bar higher.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After all, I'm the one who said I wanted my birthday stream to have a show segment!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you're plenty motivated.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still... It appears you're in even better shape than usual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I do feel like this is the smoothest I've been moving lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Maybe I'm in a good place because I got warmed up before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Warmed up...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. So, today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Welcome to SpoJoy Park, Airi♪
It's not quite your birthday yet, but we're gonna celebrate to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on Mizuki, you're way too excited.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for going along with this, everyone! I've been wanting to visit after hearing about this place from Ena and Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's a variety of sports and other games to be played here, yes? I haven't really been to a place like this before, so I'm rather concerned I won't be able to do things properly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, no worries!
If there's anything you're not sure about, just ask me or Ena!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. Shizuku and I are all set to enjoy the day with our disguises too, so... Let's have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
Shizuku, you're so good at roller skating!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you!
It's all because you taught me, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No way...
Does this mean I'm the worst one here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I wonder.
Should we have a race to that wall to find out?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmph... Loser buys the drink, got it?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, the claw's in a great spot!
Now this plushie is basically mine...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
Even that wasn't enough?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know your pain. The claws here are super weak.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, I totally thought you had that one too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
To think that Airi can't do it after so many tries...
Claw machines must be very difficult.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I went through a lot when I was here before...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But thanks to that, I feel like I've figured out a trick or two. I think you'll be able to get that plushie you're aiming for if you move it just a little more, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Hook the claw on the plushie's hat, not its body...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'm off to get us some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Safe travels!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you having a good time, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I am! It's been a while since I last got to hang out with everyone or get my body moving this much outside of practice, so I'm having a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, I was able to get the plushie I wanted thanks to your advice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, that's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now then!
Sudden as this is, it's now time to ask our resident Airi a question♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have you ever seen a birthday celebration that made you think, “I wish someone would do this for me”?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That really was sudden...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, a celebration I wish I could have, right? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, there was one time when another girl at my agency got a photo album as a birthday present from her group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The album was full of pictures of her singing during their shows... When I saw that, I thought it must be nice to receive a gift that has so many memories packed into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see, I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A photo album... That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Other than that... I once saw an idol show where they brought out a gigantic cake for a member's birthday. That was pretty funny.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A gigantic cake?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. It was on a table, and with that, it was about as tall as the birthday idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And she looked so happy with her mouth stuffed full of cake... That's kind of become a dream for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, that sounds great!
I bet it'd be sheer bliss to just take a big mouthful of your favorite cake.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of cake... Ena did something for me too, back in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. She brought a cake to school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our junior high was pretty strict about not bringing snacks and stuff, so we had it in secret up on the roof during lunch break.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember that.
We celebrated your birthday while sweating over what to do if a teacher showed up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That made for a birthday full of thrills.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's a really precious memory of mine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There are so many ways to celebrate a birthday... But really, just having someone to celebrate with is plenty.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That goes for everyone here today... It makes me really happy that you're all here going along with what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you both so much for today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe, we should be thanking you for giving us the chance to celebrate!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, it's your birthday, so of course we'd do this much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're both so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we kept doing all sorts of sports and games after that... It was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see... So you got a grand celebration.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did. I have such wonderful friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, then... I'd like it if we could celebrate today too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You'll be busy with your birthday stream on the day, so we might not be able to do it in person then!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's a bit early, but... Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's very sweet. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To think everyone would celebrate so much when it's not even my birthday yet...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no doubt in my mind that my birthday's gonna be a great day!
